about: I lead Android for C6 Assistant, C6 Bank's AI assistant launched to 35 million customers — from building the conversational interface to the launch for the entire customer base. I'm a software engineer focused on development and problem solving, and I also use AI as an everyday tool. At C6 since 2020, I was previously on the Home Experience team: home, login, investments, profile and Design System.

Before that I was a team leader at Cubos, an Android instructor at Cubos Academy, and co-founded Space Rocket, where we built digital products from scratch. In college I researched strategy for simulated robot soccer and we became Latin American champions.
Beyond Android, I work with IoT, workflow automation and Docker/containers.
